title: Jamie Hayter, Toni Storm & the Outcasts
summary: The women’s title changes hands as former allies and rivals divide around the Outcasts.

chapters.title: Hayter defeats Storm
chapters.result: Hayter wins the women’s title, then presented as an interim championship.
chapters.context: The title match becomes a key reversal in Storm and Hayter’s rivalry.

chapters.title: Ruby chooses a side
chapters.result: Hayter retains; Ruby joins Storm and Saraya in attacking their rivals.
chapters.context: The post-match turn consolidates the Outcasts.

chapters.title: Storm takes the title back
chapters.result: Storm defeats the injured Hayter for the championship.
chapters.context: The Outcasts’ campaign culminates in another title change.
